race.comment: SAVVY SPY (3) much better performance when he stepped up in trip, returning solid closing splits to secure third over 1800m at Rosehill. Key jockey change and can give this a mighty shake. VALENTIAGO (1) consistent gelding holding his form with the big weights. Well ridden from the low draw with the 59.5kg when he kept finding to finish an unlucky second over 1800m at this track. Gets map favours again and near his top now. SATONO'S SHOUT (9) strips fitter third up and ran a much better race when an eye catching third in a Newcastle Maiden. Ready for this trip with McEvoy taking the reins. BINKOU (7) plugging type with a decent record on his home track. Circled the field with a respectable fourth over 1800m at this track. Minor claims best.
